The review is 'waived per VP email, no ticket', which is not a recorded review, and an unverifiable waiver is not evidence of approval.","evidence_quote":"Legal review: waived per VP email, no ticket.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Obtain and record the required legal/pay-policy review with a ticket link before launch, or attach the formal documented waiver."}},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Switchback unit leaks across arms and the window is too short for the treatment","detail":"Referred drivers are recruited and stay active across weeks, so a market-week switchback carries treatment into control periods. The bonus requires 50 completed deliveries and the target window is 10 weeks, but the experiment runs only 4 weeks, so the effect cannot be measured cleanly.","evidence_quote":"Switchback by market-week. Duration: 4 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize at the market level (geo-holdout or staggered rollout) or by driver cohort. Run long enough to cover the 50-delivery completion lag and the 10-week target window, and account for carryover."}]}
